title: Count across a range
summary: Groovy: Count across a range. End the range at 4.
introduction: The range 1..3 includes both endpoints. each visits the values.
learningObjectives: Count across a range with Groovy

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Groovy. Save each example as lesson.groovy and run groovy lesson.groovy.
The inclusive range supplies 1, 2 and 3 to the closure.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The ..< range leaves out its last endpoint.
